sentences.en: One of the causes of forest dieback is acid rain.
sentences.zh: 导致森林衰退的一个原因是酸雨。

sentences.en: The scientists concluded that acids in wine make it taste bad.
sentences.zh: 科学家们得出结论认为酒中的酸使其口感不佳。

sentences.en: This acid is extremely important in the industry and the laboratory.
sentences.zh: 这种酸在工业和实验室中极其重要。
